_readme: Readings relayed into the cockpit when the build host cannot reach market data
providers directly. Claude writes this file during a refresh; you can also edit
it by hand. Run 'python3 -m cockpit inbox' to print a skeleton, then
Each entry may carry: value (required), change, change_pct, prev_close, open,
day_high, day_low, year_high, year_low, as_of, market_status, note, source_url.
Anything missing that can be reconstructed (a change from a percent, a previous
close from a change) is filled in at fetch time.

us10y.note: Yahoo Finance chart API, symbol ^TNX — relayed rather than fetched by the build host, which Yahoo answers with HTTP 429 (rate limit on its IP).

us2y.note: Constant-maturity 2-year for August 2026 via tradingeconomics.com — a monthly reference figure, not an intraday print, and the oldest number on this board. No source reachable from here publishes an intraday 2-year yield: Yahoo has no 2-year index and CNBC bot-blocks this host.
